## Installation

Download the binary for your platform from the assets below.

| Platform | Asset |
|---|---|
| Linux x86_64 | `setlister-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Intel | `setlister-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `setlister-macos-aarch64.tar.gz` |
| Windows x86_64 | `setlister-windows-x86_64.zip` |

Extract and run:

```bash
# Linux / macOS
tar -xzf setlister-<platform>.tar.gz
./SetlisteR --help

# Windows (PowerShell)
Expand-Archive setlister-windows-x86_64.zip
.\SetlisteR.exe --help
```
